page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head above and the catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: quendam fingularem & pietatem crepantibus,
ducuntur, fed id ferio expetunt fcire, quàm
folidis Argumentis, & vivis rationibus tùm
divinis, tum humanis, tantarum Novationum
præceps Impetus & neceffitas poffit fusten-
tari.
At in iftis quidem Propofitionibus animad-
verto hujus generis perpauca vel in hunc
prorfus finem. Nil in Legibus luxatum quod hîc
volunt restitui, nulla Juris alieni ufurpatio ab-
dicanda, nulla Justitiæ obstructio removenda,
nulla omnino Injuriarum Compensatio, vel quic-
quam æquæ hujusmodi Reformationis roga-
tur, cui vel Ratio vel Religio, vel Prudentia Po-
litica, vel Humanum quodcunque Argumen-
tum ad annuendum impellat.
Quod vero ad summam eorum attinet, quæ
diversis temporibus perhibita, nova maximè
& difficilia videbantur, id demum perspexi,
ea, quæ olim in Regno seditiones & Ecclesiæ
Schismata habita ac legibus propterea obnoxia,
jam eò usque fiduciæ pervenisse (vulgi scilicet
clamoribus & auxilio præcipuè propugnata)
ut non satis habeant, ipsa, cum vanitate sua,
novitate, confusione tolerari, nisi hoc insuper re-
quirant, ut Leges omnes contra Illos abrogen-
tur, quin & Regimen Illud extirpeur[?], cujus Ju-
ra jam quæfrunt invadere.
Hoc ad summum eorum quæ petunt: Cæ-
tera feré sunt chartæ ineptæ & supervacuæ, in
quibus ista involvunt ideo, ut honestius pau-
lo afferantur.

page.notes: The running head is Greek, printed ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the final letter is read as Η. The word "extirpeur" is doubtful and is marked [?]. The word "quæfrunt" in the third paragraph is a misreading in my transcription and should read "quærunt"; the printed word is "quaerunt". The catchword "Mihi" is at the lower right. Long s has been normalised to s throughout, and u/v and i/j have been regularised.
